name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::QueryInterface
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 0. Null ppv returns false before any compare. Ids 1, 0x1b0aab0e and 0xbb100367 accepted (names not identified). Stores this, AddRef through slot 1, returns true. Differential: 4000 cases incl. null out and near-miss ids; AddRef counted by a recording slot 1. Mutant killed: no AddRef together with a changed id check (both mutations in one build).

name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::GetCurrent (vf29)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 29. Back element = blocks[(i>>2)&(count-1)][i&3] with i = offset + size - 1 (32-bit wrap, size 0 included); then calls slot 29 on that element and returns its result (tail jump in the original). Differential: 4000 random deques (1-8 blocks, offsets across the wrap, decoys in every other entry). Mutant killed: index off by one (size instead of size - 1). Forwarder tests below route their slot-29 call through the original code, so this test is what covers the index math for them.

name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::SetUint8 (vf4)

name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::SetUint8Array (vf13)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Writer slot 13, ret 8 (pointer, count). Per element: slot 29 on the writer, then the stream's slot 5. Naked stub: keeps eax and passes it to the worker. The stream's 8-bit slot compares the low byte only. Mutants killed: count-0 returns 0 (all seven array tests fail); stub pushes 0 instead of eax (fails with eax = vtable); stream slot 4 instead of 5 in the loop.

name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::WriteSerialized (vf25)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Writer slot 25, ret 4 (obj). Null obj: slot 29, then stream slot 9 with 0 (tail-jump in the original). Non-null: obj slot 4 with an out pointer (its ret 4 is inferred from the stack arithmetic, the saved esi is popped at the end), size = record+4 to stream slot 9, Release the out pointer (slot 2) if set, then obj slot 5 with this writer; returns its eax. The out local is set to null before the call (the original leaves it uninitialised until the callee writes it; the test's callee always writes it). Differential: 4,000 cases, null obj, null and non-null out. Mutant killed: Release skipped.

name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::WriteFlaggedObject (vf27)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Writer slot 27, ret 4 (obj). Slot 29, stream slot 5 with (obj != 0); null obj returns that eax. Else: count = obj slot 6 (no args); back slot 32 gives r1; stream slot 5 with a flag word (r1 != count) whose low byte is the flag and whose upper 24 bits are obj's (the original's setne writes only the low byte of its argument slot); back slot 32 again gives r2; if r2 == count the back's slot 35 gets obj, else slot 38 gets count; the result goes to stream slot 9 and its eax is returned. Differential: 4,000 cases, null obj, counts 0-3, slot-32 results equal to the count, count + 1 or random. The 8-bit stream slot compares the low byte only, so the upper 24 bits of the flag word are not checked. Mutant killed: branch sense swapped. Not tested: the upper bits (see above).

name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::WriteRecord (vf28)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Writer slot 28, ret 4 (record pointer). rec[0] to stream slot 15 (one word), rec[1] and rec[2] to stream slot 9, each after its own GetCurrent; returns the last stream call's eax. Differential: 4,000 random records, some with edge values in rec[0].

name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::WriteRoot (vf3)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 3: the context's 0xad095a01 face gives the group (+0x1c, slot 5); the director framework creates a write context (class 0xbb194c78, iid 0x9b194c66), pushed on the ring for the call and begun (slot 3 with root, stream, context). Writes 0xffff0001, the dependent count and per dependent its key mapped by the group face slot 3 (group, instance, instance high, type), the object count and per object the class id at +4 of what its slot 4 returns (releasing the counted info it hands out), then each object's slot 5 with the writer, stream slot 3, and slot 10 on every dependent entry. Counts are asked again on every loop step, as in the original. Differential: 1500 random worlds (with and without context and face, remaps, null infos, old ring elements): log of every call with stream words as data, the ring each object's write sees, ring words, refcounts, heap balance. Mutants: docs/subsystems/persistence.md, lane NN.

name: cGZPersistBinaryWriter::DeletingDestructor (vf31)

Slot 31: resets the vtable, destroys the ring (std::deque of counted pointers, null ones skipped; the game's 0x9bfb50 is library code reached only from here) and frees this (0x20 bytes) when flags & 1.
